nardos kai krokos, kalamos kai kinnamōmon, meta pantōn xylōn tou Libanou, smyrna kai aloē, meta pantōn tōn prōtōn myrōn. epei oun kata tēn makariotēta tēs en tō psalmō mnēmoneuomenēs epinoias, tē tou Theou boētheia pepoithuia, tas kalas anabaseis en tē kardia dietaxato, ek dynameōs eis dynamin aei proiōsa, eikotōs ta ekphrymata tou stomatos autēs paradeisos rōōn en tē teleiotera katastasei onomazetai. to de "ekphryma" pros tēn hypokeimenēn dianoian eustochōs ērmostai. to gar ekpempomenon apo tou pempontos epi ton dechomenon metabainei. touto d' an tis ek tēs synētheias tōn onomatōn mathoi, kathōs to Euangelion phēsi, tous eis tēn tēs alētheias kēryxein apostellomenous "apostolous" ton Logon onomasai. ti oun estin ho to tēs nympēs stoma ekpemptei; dēlon hoti ton tēs pisteōs logon, hos eis tous dechomenous elthōn paradeisos ginetai, dia tēs akoēs en tais kardiais autōn phyteuomenos. paradeisos de synēthōs ho polydendros kai dasys tōn phyōn topos onomazetai. hina oun mathōmen hoion to genos tōn phyōn, ha hypo tou Logou en tais psychais tōn pepisteukotōn geōrgeitai, ta dendra ha ho Logos—ho ek tou stomatos tēs nympēs ekpempomenos—geōrgei, "rōas" onomazei.

hē de rōa dysprositon tois klēptais to dendron echei, akanthōdeis te gar tous kladous proballetai, kai ton karpon entos peribolaiou pikrou te kai stryphnou tē geusei periechei te kai trephei. en de tō kairō, hotan akmasē, diarrēgnytai to peribolaion, kai phainetai ho karpos entos, horan te terpnos kai hēdys, melitōdēs tē geusei, kai ouden epichairōn, oinōdei te chymō tēn geusin glukainōn. dia touto moi dokei ho ek tou stomatos tēs nympēs ekpempomenos logos paradeison rōōn en tais psychais tōn akouontōn poiein, hina didachthōmen hypo tōn legomenōn mēdeni chalyō mēde tryphē tou parontos biou malakizesthai, alla tēn dia tēs enkrateias skleran te kai trachēian zōēn haireisthai. houtō gar ho tēs aretēs karpos aprositos tois klēptais estai, tō pikrō tēs enkrateias peribolaiō periphraxamenos, kai dia semnou kai anendotou tropou tous kakōs prosiontas hōsper tisin akanthais tityskōn. hotan de ho kairos tēn tōn karpōn apolausin paraschē, pantōn tōn karpōn hē rōa tryphē ginetai; ou gar dē damaskēnois ē balanois ē toioisde tisin apolauein dei, alla poikilē kai polytropos tōn arōmatōn physis en tois karpois heurisketai. estin gar kypros meta nardou—kalē synodos, hē men thermē, hē de euōdēs. ou gar epaineton kath' heauto to thermon, hotan phlegmone dysōdēs ē, alla dei tēn katharotēta tō thermō dia kalēs osmēs martyreisthai, hina ho tēs dysōdous thermotētos apokathartheis en Pneumati zeōn genētai. en toutois de tois karpois kai ta loipa arōmata heurēsei tis: nardon, phēsi, kai krokon. alla peri men tēs tēs nardou euōdias en tois anōterō dielexametha; loipon de...
